paper_title: New Constraints on Hidden Photons using Very High Energy Gamma-Rays from the Crab Nebula
suggested_experiment_name: Crab Nebula VHE gamma-ray hidden photon oscillation (HEGRA/H.E.S.S./MAGIC/Whipple)
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing chi, dimensionless, exactly as plotted on the y-axis
notes: Paper derives new constraints on hidden photon kinetic mixing chi vs mass mu from photon disappearance in VHE gamma-ray spectra of the Crab Nebula (HEGRA, H.E.S.S., MAGIC, Whipple). Combined limit chi_fit = 0.0343 (values chi >= chi_fit excluded), stated to converge to this value with increasing mass; method valid for mu <~ 1e-5 eV. Fig. 2 spans mu = 1e-8 to 1e-5 eV, with the bound degrading below ~1e-7 eV (oscillation length exceeds Crab distance ~2 kpc); only the asymptotic value is given numerically, so I emit the flat converged bound over 1e-7 to 1e-5 eV and omit the degraded low-mass region. IMPORTANT: the paper's stated confidence level is 68.3% (Delta chi2 = 1), not 90/95% — schema forces 0.90, but actual C.L. is 68.3%.
